extension_description.message: Fills logins and one-time codes from Amethystora Vault, on a click and only on the site they belong to. Needs Amethystora with the Vault set up.

closed_vault.message: The Vault is closed. Open it, then try again.

same_site_note.message: Saved for another address on $SITE$. You are on $HERE$.

exists.message: This account's login is already in the Vault. To change it, use the Vault's window.

code_goes_to.message: This fills a code of $ACCOUNT$ into $SITE$.

nothing_until_click.message: Nothing fills until you click here.

nothing_here.message: Nothing in the Vault belongs to $SITE$.

show_button.message: Show a button in this site's fields

hide_button.message: Stop showing the button on this site

no_field.message: There is no field for that on this page.

no_match.message: That does not belong to $SITE$, so nothing was filled.

cross_site.message: This is a frame from another site, so nothing fills here.

not_a_page.message: The Vault fills on web pages only.

no_access.message: The browser lets no extension into this page.

no_host.message: The Vault is not connected to this browser. In a terminal, run: ame vault browser on

no_suffix_list.message: This computer's public suffix list is missing, so sites cannot be told apart and nothing fills.

failed.message: The Vault's service could not do that. Try again in a moment.

too_large.message: That is too large for the Vault.

form_elsewhere.message: This page's form sends what you type to another site, so nothing fills here.
